title: Green lentil salad with goat cheese and hazelnuts
blurb: Earthy lentils with creamy goat cheese, toasted hazelnuts and fresh herbs
steps: Rinse the lentils and place them in a pan with plenty of cold water. Bring to the boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes until tender but still holding their shape.
Meanwhile, peel and finely dice the carrot, and finely slice the red onion.
Toast the hazelnuts in a dry frying pan over medium heat until golden, then roughly chop them.
Chop the parsley and strip the thyme leaves from their stems.
Drain the lentils well and tip them into a serving bowl while still warm.
Add the carrot, red onion, olive oil, red wine vinegar, salt and pepper to the lentils and mix well.
Stir through most of the parsley, thyme and hazelnuts, reserving some for the top.
Crumble the goat cheese over the salad and scatter with the remaining herbs and hazelnuts.
